maya: Heads-up: running a short rolling maintenance in apac-southeast1 tonight 23:00-00:30 SGT. Goal: drain small cohorts and reload GPU drivers to fix NVMe timeouts during KV-cache warm. Expect brief p99 spikes, Hosted API stays up via smart routing.

maya: Plan: cordon+drain 3 cohorts (~10% each), canary on 2 nodes, driver reload + nic micro-retry tweak, uncordon and let KV reseed (~5m). Overflow to eu-west1 for non-pinned traffic if p99 > threshold.

maya: Canary commands:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-node-canary-01
kubectl drain gpu-node-canary-01 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120 --timeout=600s
kubectl uncordon gpu-node-canary-01
```

oncall-ryan: I'll own telemetry and alerts. Setting abort triggers now.

maya: Abort criteria: p99 > 2x baseline for 2m, /v1/generate 5xx >0.5% for 3m, Dedicated throughput <85% commit for 5m.
